note: The subscription-lifecycle races level 2's surfaces make possible: a panel that opens at the moment its contents change, and a relationship that forms while the list showing it is being fetched. Fetch-on-open architectures pass every sequential test and fail exactly here. Every criterion is withheld at 0 points until it demonstrably fails a real build AND its mutant is CAUGHT — same promotion rule as contention.

features.name: A panel opened at the moment its contents change

criteria.desc: a profile panel opened at the same moment the bio is saved converges on the NEW bio — the panel's subscription outlives its opening fetch
criteria.note: WITHHELD until proven against a mutant (fetch-on-open-no-subscribe) and a real failing build. A fetch-on-open panel that races the save shows bio-before-race forever; a subscribed panel converges.

features.name: A friendship formed while the list showing it is fetched

criteria.desc: the accept lands while the asker's client is mid-refresh: the new friend appears exactly once — not zero (stale fetch), not twice (fetch merged with the accept broadcast)
criteria.note: WITHHELD until proven against a mutant (fetch-then-append-dupe) and a real failing build. The reload is what forces the asker's client into a full refetch for the accept to race.
